author: Ash

copy.intro: Maybe your nearest Macy's is one of the roughly 150 it plans to close. Or maybe you just want to see where else national brands and house labels share a rack. Either way, these stores do Macy's job. Department stores come first, then the off-price and big-box chains people turn to for the same reason, each with a note on who it suits.

bodies.kohls:
Kohl's is where we'd look first if Macy's prices are the reason you're leaving. It sells moderately priced clothes, shoes, beauty and home, which covers most of a Macy's trip.

The label setup will feel familiar. Where Macy's has Charter Club and Style & Co., Kohl's has Sonoma Goods for Life, Apt. 9 and Croft & Barrow, and it prices them under the national brands on the same floor. LC Lauren Conrad and Simply Vera Vera Wang are only sold here.

It's easy to reach, with 1,153 stores in 49 states, and it sells Sephora beauty, so the makeup run comes along too. What it doesn't do is designer. For that, Bloomingdale's or Nordstrom are the step up.
bodies.nordstrom:
Nordstrom is the closest match if you liked Macy's for its brand names and want more of them. Women's jeans run from $20 to $835, with Levi's Wedgie High Waist Bootcut ($110) and Madewell's The Straight Super Stretch ($148) near the middle.

Two policies make it easy to shop from home. Shipping is free anywhere in the US with no minimum, and returns have no time limit. So a store that's a long drive away is less of a problem here. Sizes run 00 to 28W, with petite and plus.

If MOTHER's Lil' Kick It ($248) is more than you'd spend, Nordstrom Rack is the same company's off-price chain, with jeans from $15.38.
bodies.dillards:
Dillard's covers the same floors Macy's does: women's, juniors, shoes, lingerie, beauty and home. Women's jeans run $36 to $350, and NYDJ's Marilyn high-rise straight jeans ($129) sit near the middle.

The label mix is worth a look. Levi's, NYDJ, Lauren Ralph Lauren and 7 For All Mankind share the denim racks, and Dillard's Exclusive has a section of its own. Then there's the clearance side. Twenty-eight of its 272 stores are clearance centers, which do the job Backstage does at Macy's.

The catch is reach. Dillard's trades in 30 states, so outside them it's an online order. Free shipping starts at $150 ($9.95 below that), and returns get 30 days.
bodies.jcpenney:
JCPenney is the Macy's swap when you want one store for the whole family's clothes, home and beauty. It has more than 600 stores across the US and Puerto Rico, and it runs salon, portrait and optical services too.

Start with its women's Marilyn Monroe collection, sold only at JCPenney, in stores and online. Pieces start at $44, and the High-Rise Vintage Slim Jeans are $54. Around it you'll find Liz Claiborne, a.n.a. and St. John's Bay next to Levi's and Nike.

JCPenney is now part of Catalyst Brands, alongside Brooks Brothers, Lucky Brand and Nautica. If there's no JCPenney near you, Kohl's has more than 1,100 stores and a similar mix of own labels and national brands.
bodies.bloomingdales:
Bloomingdale's is Macy's own step up. Both belong to Macy's, Inc., and Bloomingdale's is the group's upscale store, running from premium luxury designers to newer contemporary labels and its own private labels.

The useful part is the outlet side. Bloomingdale's The Outlet has 25 stores coast to coast, next to 32 full-line Bloomingdale's. So you can shop it the way you'd use Macy's and Backstage, with full price at one and markdowns at the other.

Reach is the trade-off. Thirty-two full-line stores is a small fraction of Macy's 400-plus, so the nearest one may be a long way off. If you'd rather order designer labels from home, Nordstrom ships free with no minimum.
bodies.belk:
Belk is the Southeast's answer to Macy's. It's a Charlotte department store that opened its first shop in 1888. Today it has nearly 300 Belk and Belk Outlet locations across 16 Southeastern states. That count includes the Outlet stores, so there's a markdown option in the same family.

The mix is close to Macy's too. National brands sit next to Belk's private labels across women's, men's and kids' clothes, with shoes, handbags and fine jewelry alongside. Its newer Belk Market stores fit the same mix into a smaller format.

Outside those 16 states, you're shopping belk.com or the Belk app. If there's no Belk near you, Dillard's covers 30 states with a similar spread of departments, and Kohl's reaches 49.
bodies.neiman-marcus:
Neiman Marcus is the jump from Macy's to full luxury. It was founded in 1907, it has flagships in Beverly Hills, NorthPark and Coral Gables, and its fall edit runs through Saint Laurent, Givenchy and Toteme.

If you remember Last Call, its old outlet, lastcall.com now sends you to Neiman Marcus's own sale section. That's where its markdowns are, and the nearest thing it has to a Backstage. It also sells online and through remote selling, so you don't need a flagship nearby.

Neiman, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman are one company now, Exemplar Luxury Group. Treat this as the special-occasion stop. For designer labels mixed with everyday ones, Nordstrom covers both ends.
bodies.target:
Target is the pick for everyday basics close to home, with more than 2,000 stores in all 50 states. Women's jeans run $28 to $74.99, and Universal Thread's High-Rise Vintage Straight Jeans ($38) are the place to start.

Target sells its own labels, more than 45 of them, including A New Day, Universal Thread and Wild Fable. Levi's, Lee and Lucky Brand sit alongside, so you can still buy a brand name.

Returns are the quiet perk. Target's own brands can come back for a year with a receipt, and most other items get 90 days. If you want a beauty counter and a shoe department in the same trip, Kohl's is closer to Macy's.
bodies.tj-maxx:
TJ Maxx is the off-price way to keep buying brand names. It sells family clothing, shoes, beauty, jewelry and home at what TJX puts at 20% to 60% under full-price retailers' regular prices.

Look for The Runway, its high-end designer department. It's only in select stores, so check before you make a trip for it. With 1,348 stores, TJ Maxx has more doors than Kohl's, which makes it one of the easiest picks here to reach.

If you're shopping for shoes or for men, Marshalls is the same company's other chain and has bigger departments for both. For off-price you can order online and return in store, Nordstrom Rack is the one.
bodies.nordstrom-rack:
Nordstrom Rack is Nordstrom's own off-price chain, so it plays the part Backstage plays for Macy's. Women's jeans start at $15.38 for MANGO's Claudia Waxed Crop Slim Fit and reach $419.97 for Akris's Finnian wide-leg pair. In between are Levi's, Madewell, FRAME and Citizens of Humanity.

It's also a full online store. Shipping is free over $89, and online orders can go back within 40 days. Better still, you can return them free at any Nordstrom or Rack store. Sizes run 00 to 28W, with petite and plus.

It only ships to US addresses. And if you'd rather browse racks in person, TJ Maxx and Marshalls each have far more stores.
bodies.marshalls:
Marshalls is the off-price pick for shoes and menswear. It has a full line of footwear for women, men and kids, and a broader men's department than TJ Maxx. That makes it the better of the two for a family shoe run.

The two are sisters. TJX bought Marshalls in 1995 and paired it with TJ Maxx. So the rest of the mix is familiar: family clothing, beauty, accessories and home, across 1,255 stores in the US and Puerto Rico. Its website, marshalls.com, lets you browse before you drive.

If the household shop is the point, this is the TJX store we'd start at. For designer labels, TJ Maxx's Runway section or Bloomingdale's Outlet are the better bets.
bodies.burlington:
Burlington is the off-price stop for coats and plus sizes, since each has a department of its own. Its in-store deals show a ladies' dress at $19.99 and a Plus Faux Fur Coat at $69.99.

The pitch is brands at up to 60% off other retailers' prices. There are 1,287 stores across 47 states, DC and Puerto Rico, and Juniors, Kids and Baby get their own sections too. That makes it a decent one-trip option for a family.

There's no online shop, so this is an in-person visit. Ross is the other walk-in chain here and has even more stores. If you want off-price with home delivery, Nordstrom Rack is the one that ships.
bodies.walmart:
Walmart is the pick when the closest store matters most. It has 4,611 US stores, in all 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico, and its fashion aisles cover clothing for adults and kids, plus shoes, jewelry and accessories.

The labels to know are its own. Time and Tru, Free Assembly, Joyspun and No Boundaries are Walmart brands, and Sofia Jeans by Sofia Vergara is a licensed line sold there. Brand-name goods make up a big share of what it sells overall too.

Clothes are one aisle among groceries and electronics, so this is a basics run rather than a browse. Walmart+ members get free shipping on eligible items with no minimum. For national labels at off-price, TJ Maxx or Ross suit better.
bodies.ross-dress-for-less:
Ross is the off-price chain with the most stores here, 1,952 across 44 states, DC, Guam and Puerto Rico. Its pitch is aimed right at department-store shoppers. It sells name brands and designer labels at 20% to 60% off department and specialty store regular prices, every day.

That covers clothes, shoes, accessories and home for the whole family. Items vary by store, which is part of the hunt. Its website lists stores, not stock, so the only way to see what's in is to go.

There's no online shop. Ross also runs dd's DISCOUNTS, 376 stores in 23 states with more moderately priced stock. If you'd rather shop from the sofa, Nordstrom Rack is the off-price option that ships.
bodies.bloomingdales-outlet:
Bloomingdale's Outlet is the designer-leaning cousin of Macy's Backstage, and it's run by the same parent, Macy's, Inc. Its stores bring together the best names in clothing, accessories and home, for less. And while most Backstage shops sit inside Macy's stores, the Outlets are stores of their own.

Bloomingdale's itself runs from premium luxury designers to newer contemporary labels, and that's the range its outlets draw on. There are only 25 of them, scattered across the country, so check the map before you count on one.

Pair it with Nordstrom Rack if you can, since both sit at the designer end of off-price. If there's no Outlet near you, Rack's website ships anywhere in the US, free over $89.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body:
Start with what you used Macy's for. If it was everyday brand names and house labels, Kohl's and JCPenney are the closest swaps, with Dillard's or Belk if you live in their states. If you want a step up, Bloomingdale's is the same family, and Nordstrom is the easiest to shop from home. Neiman Marcus is for the special-occasion splurge.

If Backstage was your favorite floor, go off-price. Nordstrom Rack is the one that ships and takes returns in store. TJ Maxx and Marshalls each have over 1,200 stores to try, while Ross and Burlington are in-store only. And for plain basics close to home, Target or Walmart will do.

faqs.a: Some stores, not the chain. Macy's, Inc. plans to close about 150 store locations under its Bold New Chapter strategy, and Macy's still has 408 locations, counting its furniture stores.
It's Macy's off-price store. There are more than 300 nationwide, nearly all of them sections inside regular Macy's stores, plus four that stand on their own.
Macy's, Inc., headquartered at 151 West 34th Street in New York. The same company owns Bloomingdale's and Bloomingdale's The Outlet.
